scope: Read-only audit of ai_construction.json, bridges_materials.json, geometry.json; final combined corpus and vault publication not yet reviewed.
method: Read titles, source URLs, declared reading levels and all Vietnamese summaries/limitations for 70 author records.
Checked exact URL and DOI duplicates across the 70 records: none found.
Computed whitespace word counts over summary, key points, limitations and project-use prose: maximum 160 words (AI-012).
Independently opened a risk-weighted sample of 22 source URLs, including 2026 preprint metadata, publisher-indexed sections, source PDF metadata and official API documentation.
Audit confirms plausibility of selected-section claims using the cited sections; it does not certify that all source text was read, all findings reproduced, or every source remains accessible.

findings.suggested_replacement_vi: Bản ghi này chỉ bao phủ phần 1 (2023); phần 2 về quản lý vòng đời đã xuất bản ngày 20-03-2024 và cần đọc riêng.

findings.issue_vi: Với mục tiêu hình hữu cơ có lỗ/rỗng, nên giữ hai giới hạn cụ thể của TessellatedShapeBuilder ngay trong hồ sơ nguồn.

confirmed_strengths: AI-012 honestly separates direct HTTP 403 from publisher-indexed selected-section reading; independent indexed search exposed methodology 3, 3.2 and 3.3, supporting the stated synthesis.
AI-014 BIM-Edit arXiv 2606.20146 is a genuine June 2026 preprint; section 3.2 and edit-graph discussion support geometry/semantics/topology synthesis. It is not a future-dated invented citation.
AI-009 uses 2024 journal volume year consistently with Springer metadata; online publication was October 2023.
BM-015 correctly records report year 2019 despite FHWA-HIF-18-041 identifier.
BM-018 metadata confirms December 2024 and named authors; treatment as a non-regulatory research/manual reference is appropriate.
BM-001 avoids stale world-ranking claim; BM-009 separates designer account from independent failure investigation; BM-011 explicitly refuses a suspect 3.5 km source figure.
GE-002 preserves same-direction-load and compression-only assumptions; GE-020 avoids equating DirectShape with parametric Family.
GE-006 accurately reflects abstract scope and does not invent a member-buckling validation.
All sampled source/title/DOI pairs matched; no invented reference or engineering approval claim found in the sampled set.

limitations: Independent external verification sampled sources rather than opening all 70 URLs.
Geographic breadth is not equivalent to global exhaustiveness.

No runtime, solver, Family import, engineering design, experiment reproduction or invention work assessed.
